fused_matmul_residual_rmsnorm.name: fused_matmul_residual_rmsnorm
fused_matmul_residual_rmsnorm.purpose: CODA fused GEMM + residual add + RMSNorm
memory_flow: Load activation tile through Vec(UB) into Left(L0A)
Load FP8/BF16 weight tile through Mat(L1) into Right(L0B)
Consume residual from Vec(UB) and normalize in Acc(L0C)
Store only final BF16 normalized output to GM
fused_matmul_residual_rmsnorm.notes: The matmul output is never materialized in HBM; residual and RMSNorm consume Acc directly.

partial_rms_sum_squares.name: partial_rms_sum_squares
partial_rms_sum_squares.purpose: Partial row-wise RMS reduction for an Acc(L0C) output tile
memory_flow: Compute row-wise sum of squares locally
Store compact partial sums for cross-tile finalization
partial_rms_sum_squares.notes: Partial sums are B-sized row vectors, not full hidden-state intermediates.

fused_matmul_swiglu.name: fused_matmul_swiglu
fused_matmul_swiglu.purpose: CODA fused expert gate/up matmul + split + SiLU(gate) * up
memory_flow: Load expert activation tile through Vec(UB) into Left(L0A)
Load packed [gate, up] weight tile through Mat(L1) into Right(L0B)
Accumulate packed gate/up output in Acc(L0C)
Split Acc columns into gate and up views
Apply SiLU and multiply in local memory
Store only the BF16 SwiGLU product to GM
fused_matmul_swiglu.notes: Gate/up tensors are not separately written to HBM.

coda_q_proj_rmsnorm.name: coda_q_proj_rmsnorm
coda_q_proj_rmsnorm.notes: Q intermediate (3.0KB) stays in Acc. K-tiling: 96 blocks.

coda_kv_proj.name: coda_kv_proj
coda_kv_proj.notes: Single weight load for K+V (2048KB). Split in epilogue.

coda_attn_out_residual_rmsnorm.name: coda_attn_out_residual_rmsnorm
coda_attn_out_residual_rmsnorm.notes: Core CODA pattern. GEMM output (4.0KB) never hits HBM.

coda_moe_gate.name: coda_moe_gate
coda_moe_gate.notes: Small kernel (0KB logits). K-tiling overhead significant.

coda_expert_swiglu.name: coda_expert_swiglu
coda_expert_swiglu.notes: Gate (4KB) and up (4KB) never hit HBM. Big CODA win.

coda_expert_down_residual.name: coda_expert_down_residual
coda_expert_down_residual.purpose: Expert down proj + residual add (×8 experts)
coda_expert_down_residual.notes: Down output (4KB) consumed by residual add in Acc.

coda_shared_expert.name: coda_shared_expert
coda_shared_expert.notes: SwiGLU intermediate (4KB) stays in Vec(UB) via A5 ring buffer.
